paragraphs.text: translated by
1. YE, who, adorned with guerdon through the sacrifice, have won you Indra's friendship and eternal life,
paragraphs.original: ये यज्ञेन दक्षिणया समक्ता इन्द्रस्य सख्यममृतत्वमानश ।
paragraphs.translit: ye yajñena dakṣiṇayā samaktā indrasya sakhyamamṛtatvamānaśa |

paragraphs.text: Even to you be happiness, Angirases. Welcome the son of Manu, ye who are most wise.
paragraphs.original: तेभ्यो भद्रमङ्गिरसो वो अस्तु प्रति गृभ्णीत मानवं सुमेधसः
paragraphs.translit: tebhyo bhadramaṅgiraso vo astu prati gṛbhṇīta mānavaṃ sumedhasaḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. The Fathers, who drave forth the wealth in cattle, have in the year's courses cleft Vala by Eternal Law:
paragraphs.original: य उदाजन्पितरो गोमयं वस्वृतेनाभिन्दन्परिवत्सरे वलम् ।
paragraphs.translit: ya udājanpitaro gomayaṃ vasvṛtenābhindanparivatsare valam |

paragraphs.text: A lengthened life be yours, O ye Angirases. Welcome the son of Manu, ye who are most wise.
paragraphs.original: दीर्घायुत्वमङ्गिरसो वो अस्तु प्रति गृभ्णीत मानवं सुमेधसः
paragraphs.translit: dīrghāyutvamaṅgiraso vo astu prati gṛbhṇīta mānavaṃ sumedhasaḥ

paragraphs.text: 3. Ye raised the Sun to heaven by everlasting Law, and spread broad earth, the Mother, out on every side.
paragraphs.original: य ऋतेन सूर्यमारोहयन्दिव्यप्रथयन्पृथिवीं मातरं वि ।
paragraphs.translit: ya ṛtena sūryamārohayandivyaprathayanpṛthivīṃ mātaraṃ vi |

paragraphs.text: Fair wealth of progeny be yours, Angirases. Welcome the son of Manu, ye who are most wise.
paragraphs.original: सुप्रजास्त्वमङ्गिरसो वो अस्तु प्रति गृभ्णीत मानवं सुमेधसः
paragraphs.translit: suprajāstvamaṅgiraso vo astu prati gṛbhṇīta mānavaṃ sumedhasaḥ

paragraphs.text: 4. This kinsman in your dwelling place speaks pleasant words: give car to this, ye Rsis, children of the Gods.
paragraphs.original: अयं नाभा वदति वल्गु वो गृहे देवपुत्रा ऋषयस्तच्छृणोतन ।
paragraphs.translit: ayaṃ nābhā vadati valgu vo gṛhe devaputrā ṛṣayastacchṛṇotana |

paragraphs.text: High Brahman dignity be yours, Angirases. Welcome the son of Manu, ye who are most wise.
paragraphs.original: सुब्रह्मण्यमङ्गिरसो वो अस्तु प्रति गृभ्णीत मानवं सुमेधसः
paragraphs.translit: subrahmaṇyamaṅgiraso vo astu prati gṛbhṇīta mānavaṃ sumedhasaḥ

paragraphs.text: 5. Distinguished by their varied form, these Rsis have been deeply moved.
paragraphs.original: विरूपास इदृषयस्त इद्गम्भीरवेपसः ।
paragraphs.translit: virūpāsa idṛṣayasta idgambhīravepasaḥ |

paragraphs.text: These are the sons of Angirases: from Agni have they sprung to life.
paragraphs.original: ते अङ्गिरसः सूनवस्ते अग्नेः परि जज्ञिरे
paragraphs.translit: te aṅgirasaḥ sūnavaste agneḥ pari jajñire

paragraphs.text: 6. Distinguished by their varied form, they sprang from Agni, from the sky.
paragraphs.original: ये अग्नेः परि जज्ञिरे विरूपासो दिवस्परि ।
paragraphs.translit: ye agneḥ pari jajñire virūpāso divaspari |

paragraphs.text: Navagva and Dasagva, noblest Angiras, he giveth bounty with the Gods.
paragraphs.original: नवग्वो नु दशग्वो अङ्गिरस्तमो सचा देवेषु मंहते
paragraphs.translit: navagvo nu daśagvo aṅgirastamo sacā deveṣu maṃhate

paragraphs.text: 7. With Indra for associate the priests have cleared the stable full of steeds and kine,
paragraphs.original: इन्द्रेण युजा निः सृजन्त वाघतो व्रजं गोमन्तमश्विनम् ।
paragraphs.translit: indreṇa yujā niḥ sṛjanta vāghato vrajaṃ gomantamaśvinam |

paragraphs.text: Giving to me a thousand with their eight marked cars, they gained renown among the Gods.
paragraphs.original: सहस्रं मे ददतो अष्टकर्ण्यः श्रवो देवेष्वक्रत
paragraphs.translit: sahasraṃ me dadato aṣṭakarṇyaḥ śravo deveṣvakrata

paragraphs.text: 8. May this man's sons be multiplied; like springing corn may Manu grow,
paragraphs.original: प्र नूनं जायतामयं मनुस्तोक्मेव रोहतु ।
paragraphs.translit: pra nūnaṃ jāyatāmayaṃ manustokmeva rohatu |

paragraphs.text: Who gives at once in bounteous gift a thousand kine, a hundred steeds.
paragraphs.original: यः सहस्रं शताश्वं सद्यो दानाय मंहते
paragraphs.translit: yaḥ sahasraṃ śatāśvaṃ sadyo dānāya maṃhate

paragraphs.text: 9. No one attains to him, as though a man would grasp the heights of heaven.
paragraphs.original: न तमश्नोति कश्चन दिव इव सान्वारभम् ।
paragraphs.translit: na tamaśnoti kaścana diva iva sānvārabham |

paragraphs.text: Savarnya's sacrificial meed hath broadened like an ample flood.
paragraphs.original: सावर्ण्यस्य दक्षिणा वि सिन्धुरिव पप्रथे
paragraphs.translit: sāvarṇyasya dakṣiṇā vi sindhuriva paprathe

paragraphs.text: 10. Yadu and Turva, too, have given two Dasas, well-disposed, to serve,
paragraphs.original: उत दासा परिविषे स्मद्दिष्टी गोपरीणसा ।
paragraphs.translit: uta dāsā pariviṣe smaddiṣṭī goparīṇasā |

paragraphs.text: Together with great store of kine.
paragraphs.original: यदुस्तुर्वश्च मामहे
paragraphs.translit: yadusturvaśca māmahe

paragraphs.text: 11. Blest be the hamlet's chief, most liberal Manu, and may his bounty rival that of Surya.
paragraphs.original: सहस्रदा ग्रामणीर्मा रिषन्मनुः सूर्येणास्य यतमानैतु दक्षिणा ।
paragraphs.translit: sahasradā grāmaṇīrmā riṣanmanuḥ sūryeṇāsya yatamānaitu dakṣiṇā |

paragraphs.text: May the God let Ssvarni's life be lengthened, with whom, unwearied, we have lived and prospered.
paragraphs.original: सावर्णेर्देवाः प्र तिरन्त्वायुर्यस्मिन्नश्रान्ता असनाम वाजम्
paragraphs.translit: sāvarṇerdevāḥ pra tirantvāyuryasminnaśrāntā asanāma vājam
